practice.prompt: A reflexive verb needs a pronoun that points back to the subject. For "ich", that pronoun is...
For "du", the accusative reflexive pronoun is...
For "er / sie / es" AND for the formal "Sie", the reflexive pronoun is...
Complete: "I'm looking forward to the weekend." (sich freuen, ich)
Complete: "How do you feel?" (sich fühlen, du)
Type the reflexive verb (infinitive, with "sich") meaning "to hurry."
"Ich wasche ___ die Hände." There's a direct object (die Hände), so the reflexive pronoun goes to the DATIVE:
Complete: "We have to hurry." (sich beeilen, wir)
Type the reflexive verb (infinitive, with "sich") meaning "to rest."
